A [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] '''sergeant''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was captured during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was brought to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and was to be auctioned off by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Morbo]] to the Empire, but was rescued in [[3640 BBY]], along with other Republic prisoners of war, by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Theron Shan]].
